CloudStack Inc. is a B2B SaaS company providing cloud-based enterprise analytics to Fortune 500 companies. Founded in 2015, we have grown to 350+ employees with $80M ARR. Our product is used by 1,200+ enterprise clients across 40 countries. We are Series C funded and on a path to IPO. Role Overview / What You'll Do We're looking for an experienced Senior PM to own our core analytics product.
